# Consistent CEO

> The local-first operating system for missions and entities. Consistent CEO
> (consistent.ceo) is a persistent, evidence-backed operating graph for people who
> run things — founders, operators, and agencies. Businesses, projects, goals,
> people, files, approvals, and memories are first-class objects, not incidental
> prompt context, and AI pushes the work forward continuously under explicit human
> oversight. Written in Rust, self-hosted, open source.

## Naming

- The product is **Consistent CEO**, at **https://consistent.ceo**. Short form: "Consistent".
- "Consistent World" is a legacy name. It survives only in internal identifiers
  (Rust crate names `consistent-world-*`, the `~/.consistent-world/` config
  directory, database namespaces, and app bundle identifiers) and in archived
  planning documents. It is not the product name.

## What it is not

Not a general AI assistant, not a coding agent, not a chat wrapper. Chat is one
surface; the product is the world model underneath it and the governance around it.

## The core promise: evidence-backed execution

Every consequential claim resolves to a citation — the entity registry, stored
memory, or a cached external source. Every consequential action passes a policy
gate (auto-allow, require approval, or deny). Claims carry visible evidence states:
Verified, Observed, Inferred, or Unverified. Only Verified and Observed claims may
trigger side effects, and only under policy. The system is built to behave as an
adversarial validator rather than a cheerleader: it challenges assumptions, asks
instead of guessing, and refuses to fabricate.

## Surfaces

- Gateway (Rust) — the server; embeds and serves the web dashboard, default `http://127.0.0.1:18800`
- Web dashboard (SvelteKit SPA) — missions, entities, tasks, approvals, chat, voice
- Desktop app (Tauri) — macOS/Windows/Linux, with dictation and text injection
- Mobile app (Expo) — capture on the go
- iOS companion app (Xcode)
